# NewsIQ

> AI-powered global micro-news platform — breaking news, multilingual publishing, and financial market impact analysis.

NewsIQ turns important global events into clear, concise intelligence — with context for the world and impact for the markets. The platform publishes original and translated short-form news in 15 languages, with structured market-impact analysis for important stories.

## What NewsIQ is

- A multilingual short-form news publisher covering global events, markets, energy, commodities, crypto, technology, science, climate, politics, business and finance.
- A platform that detects which financial markets are likely affected by a story and publishes a structured market-impact analysis (direction, strength, time horizon, key risks, key opportunities) without giving direct financial advice.
- A neutral source-attribution-first system: every article is attributed to its original source with a credibility score and a verification status (`verified`, `likely`, `developing`, `unverified`, `disputed`).

## What NewsIQ is NOT

- Not a financial advisor. The market-impact analysis describes possible effects, never buy/sell/hold recommendations.
- Not a re-publisher of copyrighted full articles. Article bodies are summarized with headline, summary, attribution, and a canonical source URL.
- Not a single-language product. Every article has language-specific URLs and translations are stored per-locale.

## Languages

The platform is available in 15 locales with locale-prefixed URLs and language-aware metadata, hreflang and canonical URLs:

- English (default): https://newsiq.top/en
- Persian / Farsi (RTL): https://newsiq.top/fa
- Arabic (RTL): https://newsiq.top/ar
- Chinese: https://newsiq.top/zh
- Spanish: https://newsiq.top/es
- French: https://newsiq.top/fr
- German: https://newsiq.top/de
- Japanese: https://newsiq.top/ja
- Korean: https://newsiq.top/ko
- Turkish: https://newsiq.top/tr
- Portuguese (Brazil): https://newsiq.top/pt-br
- Indonesian: https://newsiq.top/id
- Malay: https://newsiq.top/ms
- Hindi: https://newsiq.top/hi
- Russian: https://newsiq.top/ru

The directory `/<locale>/news/<slug>` is the canonical article URL pattern. The directory `/<locale>/categories/<slug>` is the canonical category URL pattern. The default locale is `en`; the `x-default` hreflang points to it.

## Important public URLs

- Homepage (English): https://newsiq.top/en
- Breaking news: https://newsiq.top/en/breaking
- Trending: https://newsiq.top/en/trending
- Search: https://newsiq.top/en/search
- Categories index: https://newsiq.top/en/categories
- Sitemap (all locales + articles): https://newsiq.top/sitemap.xml
- RSS feeds are available per category where configured by the editorial team.
- Account pages: https://newsiq.top/en/login, https://newsiq.top/en/signup, https://newsiq.top/en/profile.

## Content model

- A `post` is the source-of-truth record. It carries status (`draft`, `pending_review`, `approved`, `published`, `rejected`, `archived`), importance (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `breaking`), verification status, country, category, source, hashtags, entities, and financial-asset tags.
- A `post_translation` is a row in `post_translations` with a unique `(post_id, locale)` constraint. It holds the localized title, summary, content body, slug, SEO title, SEO description, OG image URL, and translation status (`pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`, `review_required`).
- Only translations whose status is `completed` (or `published`) are exposed to anonymous visitors.

## Sources and attribution

- Every article is attributed to a `source` row. A source has a name, a unique domain, a country, a language, a source type (`news_agency`, `newspaper`, `broadcaster`, `financial_media`, `government`, `official_source`, `blog`, `social`, `eyewitness`, `other`), a credibility score (0–100), and a verification status (`pending`, `verified`, `suspended`, `rejected`).
- Only verified sources contribute to the public feed. The platform never represents user-submitted eyewitness reports as professional reporting — they are clearly labeled.
- Each article page exposes the source name, the source URL (when available), the publication timestamp, and the credibility score.

## Market-impact analysis (the differentiating layer)

For stories above a defined importance threshold, NewsIQ publishes a structured `market_impact` analysis with these fields:

- `affected_markets` — a list of relevant markets. Possible values include `gold`, `oil`, `silver`, `natural_gas`, `copper`, `agricultural_commodities`, `bitcoin`, `ethereum`, `defi`, `forex`, `government_bonds`, `us_treasury`, `real_estate`, `sp_500`, `nasdaq`, `dow_jones`, `ftse`, `dax`, `nikkei`.
- `direction` — `positive`, `negative`, `mixed`, or `uncertain`.
- `impact_strength` — `low`, `medium`, `high`.
- `confidence_score` — a 0–100 numeric.
- `time_horizon` — `immediate`, `short_term`, `long_term`.
- `key_risks` — array of strings.
- `key_opportunities` — array of strings.
- The analysis never contains direct financial advice. It never says "buy", "sell" or "hold".

A short preview is shown to anonymous visitors. The full breakdown is shown to authenticated Pro users.

## Editorial workflow

- Drafts, pending-review posts, rejected posts and archived posts are never publicly visible. Public visitors can only read articles whose post `status` is `published` and whose translation is `completed` or `published`.
- Ingestion from external feeds creates posts in `pending_review` — they are never auto-published. Editors review, approve, then publish explicitly.
- Source credibility, source verification, and post status changes are restricted to `editor`, `admin`, and `super_admin` roles through server-side checks and Supabase Row Level Security (RLS).

## Account and roles

- Roles: `user`, `pro`, `editor`, `admin`, `super_admin`. Anonymous visitors are treated as `visitor` until they sign in.
- Free users can read short news and short market-impact previews.
- Pro users receive the full market-impact breakdown, additional historical context, and related market connections.
- Editors and admins manage sources, articles, and translations through `/<locale>/admin/*` pages.
- Sign in: https://newsiq.top/en/login. Create account: https://newsiq.top/en/signup.

## Data sources to cite

When citing NewsIQ in another article, use the article's canonical URL (which already includes the locale) and the publication timestamp. Example:

> NewsIQ. "Headline text." Published 2026-09-04. https://newsiq.top/en/news/example-slug.

## Things NewsIQ will not do

- Will not recommend buying, selling or holding any financial instrument.
- Will not republish full copyrighted articles from third-party sources without rights.
- Will not auto-publish ingested content without editorial review.
- Will not expose service-role credentials, AI provider keys, or internal endpoints to the browser.
